s01.visual: Rando walks up to a supermarket; a thought bubble shows a milk carton; “milk.” slams in.
“20 MINUTES LATER…” — Rando wheels an overflowing cart (chips, candle, snacks) to the till; the milk bubble gets a red ✗.
Paper card: BAD LUCK ✗ / NO WILLPOWER ✗.
Blueprint floor plan: a dot traces the shopper's route from the entrance, around every aisle, to the dairy at the back. “designed to make you spend”.
Three icons pop on each word: THE MUSIC · THE SMELLS · THE NUMBERS.
X-ray into Rando's head: a brain wearing a pilot's cap — “autopilot”.

s02.visual: Endless shelves scroll past a tiny overwhelmed Rando while a counter ticks up to “30,000+”.
The brain shakes among question marks, then a switch flips MANUAL → AUTOPILOT and a pilot cap drops on.
The autopilot brain flies a dotted route between shelves, steered by a “THIS WAY →” sign.
TITLE CARD: “how supermarkets / trick your brain / into spending more”, overflowing cart slides in.

s03.visual: REWIND: calendar flips back to 1937, clock spins backwards.
Sepia 1930s grocery: Sylvan Goldman unveils his folding two-basket cart.
A woman thinks “baby carriage”; a man folds his arms: “unmanly.”
HIRED “SHOPPERS” (SHH!) push carts through the store; a real customer starts copying them.
“bigger basket = more stuff”: hand basket → shopping cart that fills up with products.
Blueprint: MILK, EGGS and BREAD light up along the back wall.
Side-scrolling walk to the dairy past shelf after shelf; temptation “!”s pop; counter climbs to “2,000+ items”.
Rando zones out just inside the door; the floor area is labelled THE DECOMPRESSION ZONE.
Entrance display of fruit, flowers and fresh bread with smell lines; Rando's MOOD meter rises.

s04.visual: Close-up Rando with labels EARS · NOSE · EYES and floating music notes.
Split screen: SLOW MUSIC (strolling shopper, lazy notes) vs FAST MUSIC (rushing shopper, bouncing notes); “1982”.
Bar chart: slow-music days beat fast-music days, “≈ +38%”.
Wine display: French wine (flag) vs German wine (flag), a speaker playing between them; “1997”.
Two charts: French-music days (French ≈ 5 : 1) and German-music days (German wins).
A shopper holding wine is interviewed: “music? what music?”
Rando's eye line hits a highlighted shelf band: EYE LEVEL = BUY LEVEL; a coin drops (brands pay).
Top and bottom shelves glow STORE BRAND $; cereal boxes sit exactly on a kid's eye line.
End cap: a pyramid of soup cans bounces in under a “SPECIAL!” sign — tag: same price as always.

s05.visual: Price tags rain down: “it's in the numbers”.
Giant $2.99 tag; an arrow reads left → right and circles the “2”.
Number line $2 — $3: the real $2.99 sits by $3, but the “feels like” marker slides to $2.
Catalog dress: price flips $34 → $39 and the $39 sales bar grows a third taller.
WAS $10 (struck through) NOW $6; an anchor slams down; the brain cheers “a win!”.
A SALE! sign stamps onto a shelf; sales arrow goes up; the brain shrugs “?”.
“2 FOR $5” sign over cans; Rando grabs two; “= $2.50 each anyway”.
SHRINKFLATION: the same $3.99 chip bag shrinks 300 g → 260 g → 225 g.
Brain checks the price tag ✓ and skips the grams ✗.
Spotlight on Rando; his wallet sprouts legs and runs off.
Hungry Rando (growling stomach) fills a cart with non-food items; a receipt unrolls; “2015”.
A switch flips the brain into GET-MORE-STUFF MODE.
Loyalty card scanned; data flows to a screen: GUEST #48151, unscented lotion ✓, vitamins ✓, PREGNANCY SCORE bar fills; news clipping 2012.
A ceiling scanner beam sweeps over a sweating Rando: “it's reading you”.

s06.visual: Tired Rando pushes his loaded cart into the checkout queue.
Close-up of the checkout rack: candy, gum and drinks exactly at hand height; clock ticks.
Dozens of “?” decisions pop while a WILLPOWER battery drains to red; a candy bar wiggles.
England 2022: gavel slams; CHECKOUTS ✗ ENTRANCES ✗ ENDS OF AISLES ✗.
Products ride a conveyor belt straight into the cart: AUTOMATIC.
Recap tiles pop: LONG WALK · SLOW MUSIC · EYE LEVEL · ENDS IN 9 → banner “do I actually need this?”.
Rando raises a hand — STOP sign — his pilot cap flies off and the tricks fall away.

s07.visual: Checklist slides in: bring a list ✓ · eat before you go ✓ · look high and low ✓ · check the unit price ✓.
Rando sweeps a magnifying glass over the shelves; “TRICK!” bubbles pop.
Callback: Rando proudly holds up the milk at the till — receipt $1.29, sparkles.
End card: Randos in 60s logo, cursor clicks SUBSCRIBE → SUBSCRIBED, bell rings, Rando waves.
